name: smwsprites-nitro-crate-v1
title: Nitro Crate v1.0
description:
I decided to create the Nitro Crate from Crash Bandicoot. Even more, I wanted to share it on this site!

Anyway, below is the description.

The Nitrous Crate is a sprite that will explode when it is touched. There are a few minor issues that can be easily worked around.

#1: The Nitro Crate sprite uses SP1, however... it's blast uses SP4. So, SP's = SP1= ExGFXxx SP4= GFX02 or ExGFXxx

#2: It will only explode if Mario touches, not when a koopa does.

#3: It doesn't hop... yet.

Please give credit if used.

Now SA-1 compatible.
